description: FREE. Net USD outflow from Binance's publicly identified wallets over the last 1h and 24h, all chains and per chain (Ethereum, BSC, Base, Tron, Bitcoin), Chainlink-priced, with as-of time and block. Per chain check_1h/check_24h state (checked_ok, checked_ok_empty = real zero, not_checked = null total, error) with last_success_at/last_error_at; spread_ok/max_spread_seconds (limit = measured loop cycle + grace). BSC is 1h only. binance_flows ($0.02) adds per-asset detail; binance_flows_report ($0.25) adds biggest withdrawals and destinations.
name: free_binance_flows
title: Binance withdrawal-restart net flows headline (free)
